# Test fixtures

Provenance and regeneration: `make_fixtures.py`.

Third-party audio, used unmodified (VIVAE) or cropped to 4 s (ESC-50), for
non-commercial research and teaching only:

- `vivae_pain_groan.wav`: Holz, N., Larrouy-Maestri, P., & Poeppel, D. (2020).
  *The Variably Intense Vocalizations of Affect and Emotion Corpus (VIVAE)*.
  Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4066235. CC BY-NC 4.0.
  File `S02_pain_strong_021.wav`.
- `ward_noise_4s.wav`: Piczak, K. J. (2015). *ESC: Dataset for Environmental
  Sound Classification*. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/YDEPUT. CC BY-NC 3.0.
  File `1-21896-A-35.wav` (washing machine), first 4 s.
